included: Offline vanilla GALE01 gameplay and presentation, including the source-enumerated fighters, moves, costumes, transformations, partner and boss entities, stages, items, CPU, local multiplayer, VS rules, single-player modes, minigames, events, menus, results, unlocks, trophies, movies, save and memory-card behavior, audio, graphics, input and browser lifecycle
Compiled WebAssembly execution using the pinned original source routines, source identities and disc-derived assets

The supported original CSS to SSS to four-stock Mario/Final Destination gameplay to original Results to CSS path as a partial integration baseline; separate bounded CPU9 four-player routes do not establish human four-player acceptance
excluded: Netplay, online services and rollback transport
Custom fighters, custom stages, mods and user-authored content
Non-vanilla product extras and revisions other than the pinned GALE01 revision 2 source
Tournament acceptance or a claim that the browser is already a complete game
limitations: Version 1 decomposes the 26 playable CharacterKind identities and 31 named VS-stage slots. Items, mode-specific entities and service categories still require source-identity decomposition before they can serve as a fine-grained completion list.

Statuses are scoped observations, not percentages. A source path, parser, compile, synthetic scene, short prefix or recorded-queue comparison does not by itself pass browser gameplay, retail equivalence, pixels, PCM, input latency or performance.

The eight-fighter/four-stage starting baseline and each added development candidate have partial claims only; source integration does not imply complete moves, costumes, CPU behavior, human local input, audio fidelity, Results equivalence, save progression or mode coverage. Bounded CPU9 four-player routes do not establish human four-player input or retail/whole-game acceptance.

The fine-grained VS-stage census covers named StKind values from St_Kind_Izumi through St_Kind_Last; Dummy/Test and route, minigame and other mode-only stage slots remain represented by the aggregate stage rows until their callers are decomposed.
STATUS.md remains the changing evidence index. This inventory links stable evidence documents and receipts without copying measurements from STATUS.md.
Missing or untested behavior stays represented as not_integrated or not_evaluated until an owner records the required source, browser and reference gates.
